title: Prime-power diagonal smooth orientation over a Noetherian base
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda_n=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$. Let $p:P\to X$ be smooth, separated, of finite type and of pure relative dimension $r\geq0$ between Noetherian schemes with $\ell$ invertible [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Assume $p$ compactifiable [def-asd-compactifiable]. Use the ordinary small-etale derived categories and the compact-support right adjoint $p_n^!$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], with Tate twists [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist]. The diagonal first-Chern-class and deformation-to-the-normal-cone construction gives an orientation
$$\gamma_{p,n}:\Lambda_{n,P}(r)[2r]\xrightarrow{\sim}p_n^!\Lambda_{n,X}.$$
The inverse orientation is obtained from diagonal base change $p_n^!\Lambda_{n,X}\cong\Delta^*(p_1)_n^!\Lambda_{n,P}$, deformation of the diagonal section of $p_1:P\times_XP\to P$ to the zero section of $T_{P/X}$, and the zero-section restriction of inverse Kummer-normalized vector-bundle purity. Vector-bundle purity is normalized by integrating $c_1(\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^1}(1))$ to $1$, and by the ordered product on affine space. For every $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda_n)$, this orientation and the counit-defined exceptional tensor map give an isomorphism $p^*K(r)[2r]\xrightarrow{\sim}p_n^!K$.

These specified maps commute with Noetherian base change, open and etale restriction, and composition of smooth maps under exceptional transitivity. At relative dimension zero they are the etale adjunction comparisons. For $N\geq n$, coefficient reduction carries $\gamma_{p,N}$ to $\gamma_{p,n}$ under the counit-defined coefficient comparison; the comparison of Tate lines is induced by $u\mapsto u^{\ell^{N-n}}$. This assertion is on ordinary etale categories, without excellence or a ground-field hypothesis.

source.place: Theorem 7.19 and proof, and following paragraph on diagonal deformation and the Tate identification; finite prime-power ordinary-etale specialization. Uses the same general-Noetherian diagonal/DNC construction as the existing nodes thm-asd-smooth-tensor, prop-asd-smooth-base-change, lem-trf-finite-ring-section-deformation and thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity. Composition and coefficient normalization are the coordinate-tower and Kummer functoriality of that construction; this node states that extension explicitly rather than taking a trace-based construction.
